paeLayout: DSSEv1 SP LEN(type) SP type SP LEN(payload) SP payload

accept.name: spec_hello_world
accept.description: Canonical protocol.md test vector; output must never change.

accept.name: utf8_multibyte_type
accept.description: LEN counts bytes, not Unicode code points: 3 CJK characters are 9 UTF-8 bytes.

accept.name: binary_payload
accept.description: Legitimate non-UTF-8 binary body stays byte-identical inside PAE; only the type must be UTF-8.

reject.name: type_at_boundary_plus_one
reject.description: One byte over the shared type bound must be rejected before LEN is serialized.

reject.name: payload_at_boundary_plus_one
reject.description: One byte over the shared body bound must be rejected before LEN is serialized.

reject.name: type_non_utf8_bytes
reject.description: A non-UTF-8 type sequence (FF FE) cannot be decoded and must be rejected, never substituted.

reject.name: type_lone_surrogate
reject.description: A lone surrogate string has no UTF-8 encoding and must be rejected (no replacement bytes).
